subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — Insurely
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@insurely.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@insurely.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — Insurely

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from our side and a proposed evaluation plan to make the POC as low-friction and measurable as possible. Attached is a one-page evaluation plan and the demo recording.

Demo highlights (tailored):
- Real-time claims triage: showed intent classification + entity extraction with <1s median latency on our hosted runtime.
- Policy Q&A: grounded responses using your policy documents + retrieval pipeline.
- Cost controls: prefix caching + batching options to reduce unit cost for high-throughput requests.

Proposed POC scope (3-week core evaluation, flexible):
- Goal: validate accuracy and latency for claims triage + confirm integration feasibility with your ingestion pipeline.
- Success criteria (examples):
  - Triage classification F1 >= 0.86 on holdout sample (we'll run the exact test),
  - Median inference latency <= 800ms for 512-token average payload in your region,
  - End-to-end integration with your staging API, returning structured JSON payloads.
- Deliverables: evaluation report, recommended config (batching/quant), and next-step cost estimate.

High-level timeline (can adjust to your calendar):
Week 0 (kickoff): access & data sync, scope confirmation, baseline metrics
Week 1: integration & ingest test dataset (customer provides sample)
Week 2: run evaluations & iterate on prompts/config
Week 3: results analysis + handoff to eng/ops + optional optimization sprint

Ownership:
- Redwood: Camila (commercial lead) and Dylan (SE / technical lead)
- Insurely: Priya (product lead) and Alex (engineering lead)

Next steps:
1) Confirm scope and whether you want hosted (Redwood API) or Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) for the POC.
2) If okay, propose kickoff week of Nov 16 — does that work?
3) Please upload a representative sample dataset (anonymized) or let us know constraints; Dylan will share exact schema requirements.

Attachments: insurely_poc_evaluation_plan.pdf, demo-recording-20261110.mp4

Thanks — happy to iterate on the success criteria if you have internal KPIs we should include.

—Camila
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@insurely.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@insurely.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T18:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — Insurely

Thanks Camila — really helpful recap and appreciate the clear next steps. A few quick questions from our side before we lock dates: 

1) Data/privacy: can Redwood run the POC in our VPC/staging environment? For regulatory reasons we prefer not to send PHI outside our network.
2) Success criteria: the F1 target looks reasonable, but can you add precision/recall breakdowns and a sample evaluation script so our ML team can reproduce?
3) Timeline: Q4 is tight for us — Nov 16 kickoff might be ok, but could we extend the POC to 4 weeks to accommodate internal test case collection and procurement?

If answers to 1 & 2 are yes, we can commit to a kickoff week of Nov 16 and confirm owners. I'll check with Alex on dataset availability and get back by EOD tomorrow.

—Priya
Priya Sharma
Senior Product Manager, Insurely
priya.sharma@insurely.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@insurely.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@insurely.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-11T09:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — Insurely

Priya — great questions. Short answers up front and then an updated plan.

1) Private deployment: yes — we support a Private deployment (VPC peering or customer-hosted control plane) for the POC. That model is common for customers handling PHI. We'll share a minimal access checklist (Dylan will follow up with specifics).
2) Evaluation artifacts: we'll provide the exact evaluation script, scoring notebook, and a reproducible metric breakdown (precision, recall, F1) so your team can validate results offline.
3) Timeline: happy to extend to 4 weeks. Updated timeline below assumes Nov 16 kickoff and adds an extra integration/testing week.

Updated 4-week timeline:
- Week 0 (kickoff, Nov 16): finalize scope, sign access forms, and exchange sample dataset (anonymized)
- Week 1: environment setup (hosted vs Private), ingestion & schema validation
- Week 2: model runs + evaluation script execution
- Week 3: iteration on prompts/config, latency tuning
- Week 4: results, recommendations, and next steps

Action items I can own from Redwood:
- Share evaluation plan + script (attached PDF) — Camila
- Technical access checklist and schema requirements — Dylan (cc'd)
- Prepare an SOW/DocuSign for the POC engagement — Marissa (cc'd)

If Nov 16 works, we'll schedule a 30m kickoff to walk through access and timelines. Priya — if you can confirm dataset availability and VPC preference, we'll lock dates.

- If you confirm Nov 16 kickoff by end of day Tuesday (Nov 14), we can prioritize resources and provision a Private environment if needed.
